name: GAN V100 3x3 Leap (Magnetic, Core Magnets) - New Year Edition
description: The GAN V100 3x3 Leap (Magnetic) – New Year Edition is a lightweight, competition-ready 3x3 magnetic speed cube that pairs fast, accurate turning with a special Year of the Horse theme. Piece magnets give each move a crisp “click,” while core magnets add extra stability and stronger re-alignment for cleaner solves at higher TPS.
features: More accurate turning: Magnetic piece positioning helps turns land where you intend—great for consistency and speed.
More stable at high speed: Core magnets improve control and reduce “wobbly” turning during fast solves.
Superlight feel: At 62g, it’s easy on the hands for long practice sessions and averages.
Limited edition design: Year of the Horse theme details, orange internals/logo, and special packaging make it collectible.
35° auto-alignment: Helps the cube snap into place to reduce lockups and improve flow.
Omni-directional core positioning: Designed to keep turning stable from any angle.
